Desecrated Tomb.text: **Thranduil:** "…leave your graveyard, create a 1/1 black Bat" — Muldrotha, Kotis, Sheoldred, Whispering One and Liliana's +1 trigger it, but Teval and Insidious Roots already pay off the same event better. **Glarb:** Glarb's mill fills the opponent's yard; its own creature cards rarely leave the graveyard.

Chalk Outline.text: **Thranduil:** "Whenever one or more creature cards leave your graveyard, create a 2/2 … then investigate" — a second Insidious Roots for the Muldrotha/Kotis/Vile Offering recasts; 4 mana that does nothing until one happens. First reserve. **Glarb:** Own-yard recursion is not the plan.

Attuned Hunter.text: **Thranduil:** "Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard during your turn, put a +1/+1 counter" — Kotis, Muldrotha and Teval trigger it, but the payoff is only a growing 3-mana trampler with no card or mana. **Glarb:** Off-plan.

Kishla Skimmer.text: **Thranduil:** "Whenever a card leaves your graveyard during your turn, draw a card" (once a turn) fires off Kotis's exile cost, Muldrotha and Kagha casts, Sheoldred's upkeep reanimation and Teval's land return — a 2-mana repeatable draw beside Elrond. **Glarb:** Its own yard rarely empties; off-plan.

Undead Hand Ninja.text: **Thranduil:** "Whenever one or more creature cards leave your graveyard" drains 1 off Sheoldred, Kotis and Muldrotha, but a 1-point drain on a 2/1 is too small. **Glarb:** Its own yard rarely loses creatures; off-plan.

Dredger's Insight.text: **Thranduil:** A 2-mana mill four that keeps an artifact, creature or land — fuel plus a card; the lifegain fires off Muldrotha, Kotis and the reanimators, but it is a one-shot beside the repeat self-mill (Kagha, Sidisi, Overlord). **Glarb:** Own-library mill is not the plan.

Along the Crooked Way.text: **Thranduil:** "return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand" is one regrowth (pick a non-Elf so Thranduil keeps his tools), and every Muldrotha/Kotis/Vile Offering recast then grows a lone Goblin Army; the menace line has no other Goblins or Orcs. **Glarb:** Own-yard regrowth is not the plan.

Willow Geist.text: **Thranduil:** A 1-drop that gets a +1/+1 counter whenever cards leave your yard (Kotis's exile cost, Muldrotha, Sheoldred's reanimation, Teval's land), but a body, not an engine. **Glarb:** Its own yard rarely changes; off-plan.

Courser of Kruphix.text: **Thranduil:** Lands from the top plus a life per land, and each land feeds Sindarin Liege's landfall tokens. **Glarb:** Lands from the top plus life; Glarb does the first part. `{1}{G}{G}` on 15 green sources.

Augur of Autumn.text: **Thranduil:** Lands from the top, and coven is easy with this many creatures of different powers, so creatures come off the top too (Eladamri does the creature half already). **Glarb:** "You may play lands from the top" — Glarb does it; the creature half needs coven in a 21-creature control deck.

Oracle of Mul Daya.text: **Thranduil:** An Elf: extra land drop and lands from the top, and each land feeds Sindarin Liege's landfall tokens. **Glarb:** Extra land drop plus Ruin Crab's landfall; Glarb already plays lands from the top.

Precognition Field.text: **Thranduil:** Seven instants and sorceries to cast off the top; little to find. **Glarb:** 21 instants and sorceries, and it covers the cheap ones Glarb cannot (Counterspell, Drown in the Loch, the 2-mana removal); its {3} exile clears a dead top card. Bench.

Vivien, Monsters' Advocate.text: "You may cast creature spells from the top of your library"; +1 makes a 3/3 Beast. **Thranduil:** Card advantage in a creature-dense list, plus a token a turn for Yawgmoth, Izoni and Insidious Roots; overlaps Eladamri. **Glarb:** About 20 creatures, mostly utility, and {3}{G}{G} on a green splash.

Eladamri, Korvecdal.text: **Thranduil:** In the list: a legendary Elf (Thranduil loot), "cast creature spells from the top of your library" with 45 creatures, and in the yard Thranduil borrows `{G}, {T}, Tap two untapped creatures: … put it onto the battlefield` — a free creature each turn. **Glarb:** ~20 creatures, and Glarb already plays the top; little here.

Inside Information.text: **Thranduil:** Exiles the opponent's library, which this deck does not care about. **Glarb:** Exile X from their library (progress toward decking) and play them this turn for life; a one-turn burst.

Deathrite Shaman.text: **Thranduil:** In the list: a 1-mana Elf with three activated abilities, so Thranduil borrows all three from the yard. Point it at the OPPONENT'S graveyard to spare Elf cards; exiling your own non-Elf lands or creatures triggers Teval's Zombie, Oasis's seek and Insidious Roots. **Glarb:** The land ability ramps off their milled yard and `{B}` drains 2, but each exile shrinks the graveyard Drown in the Loch and Consuming Aberration count.

Llanowar Elves.text: "{T}: Add {G}." — **Thranduil:** In-list 1-drop accelerant feeding the Elf/mana engine; an Elf whose ability Thranduil keeps from the yard. **Glarb:** A green-only dork in a U-heavy control list that already has Birds and Paradise Druid.

Elvish Mystic.text: "{T}: Add {G}." — **Thranduil:** In list: turn-one ramp, and in the yard Thranduil borrows the mana tap. **Glarb:** A green-only dork in a U/B-heavy list that already runs Birds, Paradise Druid and four rocks.

Paradise Druid.text: "{T}: Add one mana of any color. / hexproof while untapped" — **Thranduil:** Elf mana fixer whose any-colour tap ability Thranduil borrows from the yard (doubled by Dionus); core keep. **Glarb:** Resilient two-mana fixer that ramps to Glarb's MV4+ top-casts; real, competes with Birds/rocks.

Priest of Titania.text: "{T}: Add {G} for each Elf on the battlefield." — **Thranduil:** Elf-count mana engine with ~33 Elves, and in the yard Thranduil taps for it too. **Glarb:** With only Paradise Druid as another Elf it is a 2-mana mono-G dork.

Elvish Archdruid.text: "{T}: Add {G} for each Elf you control." — **Thranduil:** Core mana engine at 33 Elves, and Thranduil taps for the same amount once it is in the yard. **Glarb:** Glarb's list holds one Elf (Paradise Druid), so it is a 3-mana single-G dork.

Circle of Dreams Druid.text: "{T}: Add {G} for each creature you control." — **Thranduil:** In list: a go-wide mana engine, and a borrowed creature-count mana ability once it's binned. **Glarb:** Only 20 creatures and {G}{G}{G}; gives little mana here.

Marwyn, the Nurturer.text: "{T}: Add an amount of {G} equal to Marwyn's power." — **Thranduil:** Legendary Elf (loot) and mana engine; from the yard Thranduil taps for {G} equal to HIS own power (5+). **Glarb:** One Elf in the deck: grows never and taps for 1; off-plan.

Lys Alana Dignitary.text: "{T}: Add {G}{G}. Activate only if there is an Elf card in your graveyard." — **Thranduil:** Self-mill keeps an Elf in the yard so it is a 2-for-1 ramp dork, and Thranduil borrows it; the deck is already deep in mana Elves. **Glarb:** No Elf cards in the yard, so its mana never turns on, and behold costs {2} more.

Deathbloom Ritualist.text: "{T}: Add X mana of any one color, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard." — **Thranduil:** Self-mill creature deck grows X quickly, and in the yard it is a borrowed any-colour mana ability for Thranduil. **Glarb:** Glarb mills the opponent, so its own yard holds few creature cards; off-plan.

Woodland Weavemaster.text: "Spend this mana only to cast Elf spells and activate abilities of Elf sources." — **Thranduil:** In list: restricted mana, but it does pay for Thranduil's borrowed Elf-source abilities; a real slot, not a core one. **Glarb:** The only Elf in G is Paradise Druid, so the restricted mana is dead.

Selvala, Heart of the Wilds.text: "{G}, {T}: Add X mana in any combination of colors, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control." — **Thranduil:** Legendary Elf (loot) whose any-colour burst mana Thranduil can borrow; the draw half is symmetric but minor. **Glarb:** Small-creature control deck: X is low and the enters draw is symmetric; below the bar.

Fauna Shaman.text: "{G}, {T}, Discard a creature card: Search your library for a creature card" — **Thranduil:** Discarding an Elf stocks Thranduil and tutors any creature; in the yard he gains the tutor. **Glarb:** A creature tutor in a ~20-creature control deck, and the discard feeds nothing.

Imperious Perfect.text: "{G}, {T}: Create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token." — **Thranduil:** Repeatable token maker (Voice/Lathril fodder, Insidious Roots mana) that Thranduil borrows from the yard; the lord half is incidental. **Glarb:** Elf token maker with no draw, mill or interaction text.

Elvish Warmaster.text: "Whenever one or more other Elves you control enter, create a 1/1 … Elf Warrior token." — **Thranduil:** Elf-count only; its borrowed pump costs {5}{G}{G}. Cut under the synergy-first rule. **Glarb:** Elf payoff with no Elves.

Voice of the Woods.text: "Tap five untapped Elves you control: Create a 7/7 green Elemental creature token with trample." — **Thranduil:** Elf-count engine (33 Elves + token makers) and a borrowable ability; density-dependent, competes for a slot. **Glarb:** No Elves to tap; off-plan.

Trystan, Callous Cultivator.text: "Whenever this creature enters or transforms into Trystan, Callous Cultivator, mill three cards" — **Thranduil:** Repeatable mill 3 every turn plus drain/lifegain off Elf cards is core yard fuel (the exile is optional). **Glarb:** Self-mill only, which shortens your own library in a draw-heavy deck.

Lluwen, Imperfect Naturalist.text: "When Lluwen enters, mill four cards, then you may put a creature or land card from among the milled cards on top of your library." — **Thranduil:** 2-mana legendary Elf: Thranduil loot trigger, mills four, sets up the top, and leaves a borrowed Worm-token ability in the yard. **Glarb:** Mills its own library, and recursion of its own yard is not Glarb's plan.

Dwynen, Gilt-Leaf Daen.text: "Other Elf creatures you control get +1/+1. … gain 1 life for each attacking Elf." — **Thranduil:** Only a lord bonus and life, with no ability to borrow. Cut under the synergy-first rule. **Glarb:** Elf lord with no Elves.

Izoni, Thousand-Eyed.text: "Undergrowth — create a 1/1 … for each creature card in your graveyard. / {B}{G}, Sacrifice another creature: You gain 1 life and draw a card." — **Thranduil:** Legendary Elf (loot), self-mill payoff that floods the board, and a sac-draw outlet Thranduil borrows from the yard. **Glarb:** Its draws do mill via Corrosion, but G neither fills its own yard nor has creatures to sacrifice.

Harald, King of Skemfar.text: "look at the top five cards … reveal an Elf, Warrior, or Tyvar card" — **Thranduil:** Legendary Elf loot for Thranduil, but its own value is digging for an Elf (owner cut it as Elf-only). **Glarb:** Digs for Elves the deck does not run.

Cantankerous Keepers.text: "When this creature enters, mill four cards, then put all Elf cards from among them into your hand." — **Thranduil:** Cheap via affinity at 33 Elves and nets ~1–2 cards, but milled Elves go to hand instead of staying as Thranduil's tools. **Glarb:** An Elf-affinity body with own-library mill; off-plan.

Dawnhand Eulogist.text: "When this creature enters, mill three cards. Then if there is an Elf card in your graveyard, each opponent loses 2 life…" — **Thranduil:** In list: self-mill 3 fills the toolbox, and the drain is near-guaranteed. **Glarb:** Self-mill does nothing for opponent mill; the 2 life loss is only a 2-card mill through Master of Lake-town.

Elderfang Ritualist.text: "When this creature dies, return another target Elf card from your graveyard to your hand." — **Thranduil:** Owner's cut: Elf-only value that pulls a tool OUT of Thranduil's yard (G-42 shape). **Glarb:** Elf recursion in a deck with one Elf; off-plan.

Skemfar Avenger.text: "Whenever another nontoken Elf or Berserker you control dies, you draw a card" — **Thranduil:** Only draws on a nontoken Elf dying, and the deck has 2 sac outlets (owner cut it). **Glarb:** No Elves, so it is off-plan.

Morcant's Loyalist.text: "When this creature dies, return another target Elf card from your graveyard to your hand." — **Thranduil:** Lord plus a death trigger that pulls an Elf tool OUT of Thranduil's yard; cut 2026-11-02 as Elf-only. **Glarb:** Elf lord with no draw, mill or interaction text.

Gloom Ripper.text: "…gets -0/-X … where X is the number of Elves you control plus the number of Elf cards in your graveyard." — **Thranduil:** In list: X runs large with 33 Elves plus the yard, so it's real removal on a body; 5 mana keeps it from ★★. **Glarb:** X is about 1 here, so it's dead.

Leaf-Crowned Visionary.text: "Whenever you cast an Elf spell, you may pay {G}. If you do, draw a card." — **Thranduil:** Repeatable card draw off 33 Elf spells is real CA; the lord half is tiebreaker value only. **Glarb:** No Elf spells to trigger it; off-plan.

Shaman of the Pack.text: "target opponent loses life equal to the number of Elves you control" — **Thranduil:** A one-shot drain sized by Elf count with no graveyard, mana or card synergy (owner cut it). **Glarb:** Drains about 1 with no Elves.

Morcant's Eyes.text: "At the beginning of your upkeep, surveil 1. … Create X 2/2 black and green Elf creature tokens, where X is the number of Elf cards in your graveyard." — **Thranduil:** Bins an Elf every upkeep, then cashes the full Elf yard into tokens. **Glarb:** The upkeep surveil triggers Matoya and Proft for a draw; the token half is dead here.

Bounty of Skemfar.text: "…up to one land card … onto the battlefield tapped and up to one Elf card … into your hand." — **Thranduil:** A land and an Elf only; the owner cut it as Elf-only value. **Glarb:** The Elf half is dead and the rest goes to the bottom.

Harald Unites the Elves.text: "I — Mill three cards. You may put an Elf or Tyvar card from your graveyard onto the battlefield." — **Thranduil:** Self-mill plus a free Elf reanimation (a legendary one loots); trades that Elf's borrowed ability for the body. **Glarb:** Elf saga with nothing to reanimate or pump; off-plan.

Insidious Roots.text: "Whenever one or more creature cards leave your graveyard, create a 0/1 green Plant" — **Thranduil:** Muldrotha, Kotis, reanimation, Deathrite and Overlord all trigger it, and Elf/Zombie tokens tap for any colour. **Glarb:** Creature cards rarely leave its own yard and it makes few tokens.

Overlord of the Balemurk.text: "Whenever this permanent enters or attacks, mill four cards, then you may return a non-Avatar creature card or a planeswalker card from your graveyard to your hand." — **Thranduil:** Two-mana impending self-mill plus recursion, repeated on attacks: the deck's exact engine. **Glarb:** Own-yard mill and recursion isn't the plan; at most it returns one threat.

Trystan's Command.text: "Return one or two target permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand. • Destroy target creature or enchantment." — **Thranduil:** In list: recursion plus removal in one card; core keep. **Glarb:** Castable, but a 6-mana sorcery removal spell in a deck already deep in cheaper answers; the recursion and Elf modes do little.

Heartless Act.text: "Destroy target creature with no counters on it." — **Thranduil:** Two-mana instant removal for a deck that needs interaction; a core keep. **Glarb:** Premium cheap instant removal; would make most versions of the control list.

Go for the Throat.text: "Destroy target nonartifact creature." — **Thranduil:** Cheap instant removal in a deck that needs interaction. **Glarb:** Cheap instant removal for a control deck.

Infernal Grasp.text: "Destroy target creature. You lose 2 life." — **Thranduil:** Two-mana instant unconditional removal in a list whose interaction comes from outside the pile. **Glarb:** Same: cheap instant removal is a core keep in a control deck.

Command Tower.text: "{T}: Add one mana of any color in your commander's color identity." — **Thranduil:** Untapped three-colour land; core. **Glarb:** Untapped three-colour land; core.

Eclipsed Realms.text: "{T}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a spell of the chosen type or activate an ability of a source of the chosen type." — **Thranduil:** Naming Elf, its colour pays for 33 Elves and Thranduil's borrowed Elf abilities; colourless otherwise. **Glarb:** No creature of a listed type to name, so it taps for {C} in a three-colour pip deck.

Overgrown Tomb.text: "({T}: Add {B} or {G}.) … you may pay 2 life" — **Thranduil:** An untapped typed B/G dual that enables Woodland Cemetery and Wastewood Verge. **Glarb:** An untapped typed dual that enables the checklands.

Breeding Pool.text: "({T}: Add {G} or {U}.) As this land enters, you may pay 2 life." — **Thranduil:** Untapped typed dual; enables Hinterland Harbor and Wastewood Verge. **Glarb:** Untapped G/U dual covering the green splash and blue core.

Watery Grave.text: "({T}: Add {U} or {B}.) …you may pay 2 life." — **Thranduil:** In list: an untapped dual, though the off-pair for a G/B-heavy list. **Glarb:** In list: untapped U/B, this deck's main pair.

Woodland Cemetery.text: "This land enters tapped unless you control a Swamp or a Forest. {T}: Add {B} or {G}." — **Thranduil:** Usually-untapped B/G dual for the {B}{B} cards; a strong manabase keep. **Glarb:** Usually-untapped B/G dual; a strong manabase keep.

Hinterland Harbor.text: "enters tapped unless you control a Forest or an Island" — **Thranduil:** A G/U checkland that is usually untapped with the deck's typed lands. **Glarb:** Usually untapped, but G/U is the less important pair here.

Drowned Catacomb.text: "This land enters tapped unless you control an Island or a Swamp. {T}: Add {U} or {B}." — **Thranduil:** U/B is the list's lightest pair; a fine but replaceable dual. **Glarb:** U/B is this deck's core pair and 12 basic Islands/Swamps keep it untapped.

Llanowar Wastes.text: "{T}: Add {B} or {G}. This land deals 1 damage to you." — **Thranduil:** In list: untapped B/G, the deck's main pair. **Glarb:** In list: untapped, but B/G is the minor pair here.

Yavimaya Coast.text: "{T}: Add {G} or {U}. This land deals 1 damage to you." — **Thranduil:** Always-untapped G/U source; ping is minor at 25 life. **Glarb:** Always-untapped G/U source; strong manabase keep.

Underground River.text: "{T}: Add {U} or {B}. This land deals 1 damage to you." — **Thranduil:** An untapped U/B painland, U being the deck's lightest colour. **Glarb:** U/B is the deck's core pair and this land is always untapped.

Clearwater Pathway // Murkwater Pathway.text: "{T}: Add {U}. // {T}: Add {B}." — **Thranduil:** Untapped, chosen for B sources in the draft; one colour once played. **Glarb:** Untapped U or B, but only one of them per game.

Zagoth Triome.text: "({T}: Add {B}, {G}, or {U}.) This land enters tapped. Cycling {3}" — **Thranduil:** In list: all three colours and three basic types (turns on the checklands and the Verge). **Glarb:** In list: all three colours with cycling; the tapped entry is fine in control.

Underground Mortuary.text: "This land enters tapped. When this land enters, surveil 1." — **Thranduil:** Surveil bins an Elf for Thranduil; owner kept the surveil lands for exactly that. **Glarb:** Surveil triggers Matoya and Proft (a draw, which mills); worth the tapped entry.

Hedge Maze.text: "This land enters tapped. When this land enters, surveil 1." — **Thranduil:** A tapped surveil land that bins an Elf for Thranduil (the notes keep it). **Glarb:** Its surveil triggers Matoya and Proft, but it enters tapped.

Undercity Sewers.text: "This land enters tapped. When this land enters, surveil 1." — **Thranduil:** Tapped, but the surveil bins an Elf for Thranduil (the notes keep it for that). **Glarb:** Tapped, but the surveil triggers Matoya/Proft.

Darkslick Shores.text: "This land enters tapped unless you control two or fewer other lands." — **Thranduil:** In list: U/B is the minor pair, and it's usually tapped late in 100 cards. **Glarb:** In list: U/B, the main pair.

Blooming Marsh.text: "This land enters tapped unless you control two or fewer other lands." — **Thranduil:** B/G dual that is untapped only early; real but a tier below the check/shock lands. **Glarb:** Untapped only early in a long control game; a real but replaceable dual.

Botanical Sanctum.text: "enters tapped unless you control two or fewer other lands" — **Thranduil:** An untapped G/U land early; G is the main colour. **Glarb:** A late-tapped G/U fastland in a deck whose core pair is U/B.

Wastewood Verge.text: "{T}: Add {G}. {T}: Add {B}. Activate only if you control a Swamp or a Forest." — **Thranduil:** Untapped G with gated B; added in the draft for B sources. **Glarb:** No blue, and green is this list's splash (2 Forests).

Darkbore Pathway // Slitherbore Pathway.text: "{T}: Add {B}. // {T}: Add {G}." — **Thranduil:** In list: an untapped B or G source for the {B}{B} cards. **Glarb:** In list: untapped but one colour only, from the minor pair.

Psychic Corrosion.text: "Whenever you draw a card, each opponent mills two cards." — **Thranduil:** Opponent mill is off-plan for a self-graveyard deck. **Glarb:** The deck's core draw-to-mill engine (protected).

Teferi's Tutelage.text: "Whenever you draw a card, target opponent mills two cards." — **Thranduil:** Opponent-only mill is off-plan. **Glarb:** A core draw-to-mill engine.

Sphinx's Tutelage.text: "Whenever you draw a card, target opponent mills two cards. If two nonland cards that share a color were milled this way, repeat this process." — **Thranduil:** Opponent mill is off-plan for a graveyard-recursion deck. **Glarb:** A core draw-to-mill engine (on `#: protect:`).

Bruvac the Grandiloquent.text: "If an opponent would mill one or more cards, they mill twice that many cards instead." — **Thranduil:** Doubles opponent mill only; T mills itself. **Glarb:** In list: the mill doubler that halves the clock; core.

Fraying Sanity.text: "At the beginning of each end step, enchanted player mills X cards, where X is the number of cards put into their graveyard from anywhere this turn." — **Thranduil:** Opponent-mill curse; nothing in T fills their yard. **Glarb:** Repeats every turn's mill total and stacks with Bruvac/Water Crystal; a core finisher.

Ruin Crab.text: "Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, each opponent mills three cards." — **Thranduil:** Opponent mill is off-plan. **Glarb:** A 1-drop that mills about 3 per land drop (6 with Bruvac), with no draw needed.

Traumatize.text: "Target player mills half their library, rounded down." — **Thranduil:** Can self-target for ~45 cards of fuel (Muldrotha, Izoni, Morcant's Eyes), but it's a 5-mana UU sorcery that does nothing on its own. **Glarb:** A big mill that Bruvac doubles into the whole library, and Glarb can cast it from the top.

Maddening Cacophony.text: "Each opponent mills eight cards. If this spell was kicked, instead each opponent mills half their library…" — **Thranduil:** Opponent mill is off-plan. **Glarb:** In list: a kicked finisher, and with Bruvac it mills the whole library.

Startled Awake // Persistent Nightmare.text: "Target opponent mills thirteen cards. / {3}{U}{U}: Put this card from your graveyard onto the battlefield transformed." — **Thranduil:** Opponent-only mill; off-plan. **Glarb:** Big mill (26 with Bruvac) that Glarb casts off the top, with a recursion body.

Archive Trap.text: "Target opponent mills thirteen cards." — **Thranduil:** Opponent mill is off-plan. **Glarb:** A 13-card mill that Glarb can cast from the top, and it is free after their Assassin's Trophy fetch.

Glimpse the Unthinkable.text: "Target player mills ten cards." — **Thranduil:** A cheap self-mill of ten for fuel, but card disadvantage with no body or recursion. **Glarb:** Two-mana mill of ten that Bruvac and the Water Crystal scale.

Sphinx Mindbreaker.text: "When this creature enters, each opponent mills ten cards." — **Thranduil:** Opponent mill is off-plan. **Glarb:** In list: mill 10 (20 with Bruvac); 7 mana but castable off the top.

Tasha's Hideous Laughter.text: "Each opponent exiles cards from the top of their library until … total mana value 20 or greater." — **Thranduil:** Library exile has no role in T. **Glarb:** Cheap library-exile finisher (protected); core keep.

Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger.text: "When you cast this spell, exile two target permanents. … defending player exiles the top twenty cards" — **Thranduil:** Elf mana can cast it but it is off-plan, and Kinnan's put skips the cast trigger. **Glarb:** A 10-mana finisher; the library exile wins, but it needs ramp or Glarb's top.

The Master of Lake-town.text: "Whenever a player loses life, that player mills that many cards." — **Thranduil:** Self-mill from shocks and Yawgmoth life payments is incidental; the opponent-side mill is off-plan. **Glarb:** Turns damage, drains and Sheoldred's draw tax into mill; a deathtouch blocker.

Ashiok, Nightmare Weaver.text: "+2: Exile the top three cards of target opponent's library. −X: Put a creature card … exiled with Ashiok onto the battlefield…" — **Thranduil:** Castable, but library exile and theft do nothing for the graveyard engine. **Glarb:** In list: 3 mana for repeated library exile plus a stolen creature.

Consuming Aberration.text: "power and toughness are each equal to the number of cards in your opponents' graveyards. / Whenever you cast a spell, each opponent reveals … puts those cards into …" — **Thranduil:** T never fills the opponent's yard, so it is a mid-sized body; below the bar. **Glarb:** Every spell mills them and it grows with the milled yard; strong keep.

Rhystic Study.text: "Whenever an opponent casts a spell, you may draw a card unless that player pays {1}." — **Thranduil:** Card advantage, but in 1v1 the tax is often paid, and draws are not its engine. **Glarb:** Every draw it forces also mills through the Tutelages and Corrosion.

Mystic Remora.text: "Whenever an opponent casts a noncreature spell, you may draw a card unless that player pays {4}." — **Thranduil:** Blue card flow with upkeep tax in a creature-mana list; no synergy. **Glarb:** Cheap early draw engine, and each draw mills via the Tutelages/Corrosion.

Phyrexian Arena.text: "At the beginning of your upkeep, you draw a card and lose 1 life." — **Thranduil:** Steady card advantage (the first axis under the synergy-first rule), but plain, with no graveyard tie-in. **Glarb:** In list: an extra draw every turn means an extra mill trigger every turn.

Dictate of Kruphix.text: "At the beginning of each player's draw step, that player draws an additional card." — **Thranduil:** Symmetric draw hands the opponent cards with no payoff for T. **Glarb:** Each of our draws mills via Corrosion and their extra draw shortens their library; deliberate keep.

Teferi's Ageless Insight.text: "If you would draw a card except the first one … draw two cards instead." — **Thranduil:** Doubles Thranduil's loot (4 drawn, 1 discarded), but it is a 4-mana do-nothing alone. **Glarb:** Doubles every extra draw, so it doubles every mill trigger.

Notion Thief.text: "If an opponent would draw a card except the first one they draw in each of their draw steps, instead that player skips that draw and you draw a card." — **Thranduil:** A 4-mana U/B flash body with no graveyard or Elf synergy. **Glarb:** Turns Dictate of Kruphix's symmetric draw one-sided: every extra draw is ours and mills them.

Brainstorm.text: "Draw three cards, then put two cards from your hand on top of your library…" — **Thranduil:** Weak without shuffles; it puts cards back instead of binning them. **Glarb:** In list: three draws are three Corrosion or Tutelage triggers, and it feeds Reed Richards.

Kaito, Bane of Nightmares.text: "0: Surveil 2. Then draw a card for each opponent who lost life this turn. / −2: Tap target creature. Put two stun counters on it." — **Thranduil:** Surveil 2 a turn bins Elves and the stun is interaction; competes for a slot. **Glarb:** Surveil feeds Matoya/Proft draws, plus stun interaction and a hexproof body; strong keep.

Drown in the Loch.text: "mana value less than or equal to the number of cards in its controller's graveyard" — **Thranduil:** Scales off the opponent's yard, which this deck does not fill. **Glarb:** The opponent's milled yard makes it an unconditional counter or kill for 2.

Counterspell.text: "Counter target spell." — **Thranduil:** UU is hard on ~2 Islands plus the U duals; this mana is better spent on B/G removal. **Glarb:** Hard counter in a control list.

Thought Collapse.text: "Counter target spell. Its controller mills three cards." — **Thranduil:** A {U}{U} counter in a G/B-weighted list; interaction, but off-colour-weight. **Glarb:** In list: a counter plus mill 3 (6 with Bruvac).

Hero's Downfall.text: "Destroy target creature or planeswalker." — **Thranduil:** Instant creature/planeswalker removal; a strong add to T's interaction. **Glarb:** Flexible instant removal; strong keep.

Assassin's Trophy.text: "Destroy target permanent an opponent controls." — **Thranduil:** A 2-mana answer to any permanent. **Glarb:** A 2-mana answer to anything, and the fetch it gives turns on Archive Trap.

Cyclonic Rift.text: "Return target nonland permanent you don't control to its owner's hand. Overload {6}{U}" — **Thranduil:** The Elf mana engines make the 7-mana one-sided overload realistic; the cheap mode is only tempo. **Glarb:** Flexible one-sided bounce, and the overload is a reset.

Damnation.text: "Destroy all creatures." — **Thranduil:** Kills the deck's own Elf mana base and Thranduil; the reanimation to rebuild exists, but it fights the go-wide board. **Glarb:** In list: a board wipe for a control deck with few creatures that matter.

Breach the Multiverse.text: "Each player mills ten cards. For each player, choose a creature or planeswalker card in that player's graveyard. Put those cards onto the battlefield under your control." — **Thranduil:** Self-mill 10 plus two reanimations (pick a non-Elf from our yard); a big graveyard payoff the mana Elves reach. **Glarb:** Mills them 10 (doubled) and steals their best; but mills our own library 10 in a mill race; real.

Theorix Charm.text: "Counter … unless its controller pays {2} / -2/-2 / Mill three cards, then draw a card" — **Thranduil:** A flexible instant whose mill-3-draw mode stocks the yard. **Glarb:** Flexible interaction; the draw mode triggers mill but self-mills 3.

Arcane Signet.text: "{T}: Add one mana of any color in your commander's color identity." — **Thranduil:** Plain rock in a list with ~12 creature mana sources that do more. **Glarb:** Fixing ramp toward Glarb's MV 4+ top-deck casts.

Talisman of Dominance.text: "{T}: Add {U} or {B}. This artifact deals 1 damage to you." — **Thranduil:** T's ramp comes from Elves; a rock is below the bar. **Glarb:** In list: a 2-mana rock towards the MV 4+ top-deck casts.

Talisman of Curiosity.text: "{T}: Add {G} or {U}. This artifact deals 1 damage to you." — **Thranduil:** T ramps with mana Elves that Thranduil borrows; a rock is below the bar. **Glarb:** Two-mana ramp/fixing toward MV4+ casts; a real slot-competitor.

Mind Stone.text: "{T}: Add {C}. {1}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card." — **Thranduil:** The deck's Elf mana makes a colourless rock redundant. **Glarb:** Ramp toward Glarb's 4+ casts that later cycles into a draw.

Birds of Paradise.text: "{T}: Add one mana of any color." — **Thranduil:** A 1-drop that fixes all three colours (Kinnan adds); not an Elf, but mana is synergy. **Glarb:** A 1-drop fixer, though green is the splash.

Growth Spiral.text: "Draw a card. You may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield." — **Thranduil:** Instant ramp plus a cantrip that turns on Sindarin Liege's landfall; a real playable. **Glarb:** In list: a draw trigger plus ramp at instant speed.

Jidoor, Aristocratic Capital // Overture.text: "Target opponent mills half their library, rounded down. / This land enters tapped. {T}: Add {U}." — **Thranduil:** Tapped mono-U land whose spell is opponent mill; below the bar. **Glarb:** A land slot that mills half a library (all of it with Bruvac); strong keep.

Restless Reef.text: "Whenever this land attacks, target player mills four cards." — **Thranduil:** A tapped U/B land whose attack mill is mostly off-plan. **Glarb:** A tapped U/B land that becomes a mill-4 deathtouch attacker (8 with Bruvac).

Sunken Hollow.text: "This land enters tapped unless you control two or more basic lands." — **Thranduil:** U/B is the lightest pair, and it is usually untapped (15 basics) but adds nothing. **Glarb:** Usually untapped with 14 basics; the pair is fine.

Abomination of Llanowar.text: **Thranduil:** Cut 2026-11-02 as Elf-only: its P/T counts Elves plus Elf cards in the yard, and it borrows Thranduil nothing — a big menace body, not a synergy. **Glarb:** The list holds one Elf (Paradise Druid), so it is a small B/G body.

Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur.text: **Thranduil:** The Elf mana can reach ten, and seven cards at end step forces a cleanup discard that bins Elves, but UU on a light-blue base. **Glarb:** In the list: seven draws each end step is fourteen mill through Psychic Corrosion alone, more with the Tutelages and Bruvac; ten mana is the cost.

Kagha, Shadow Archdruid.text: **Thranduil:** In the list: a legendary Elf (Thranduil's loot), and "cast a permanent spell from among cards… put there from your library this turn" turns each self-mill that turn (its own two, Sidisi, Wrenn and Seven's +1, Kamahl's Druidic Vow) into a free card. **Glarb:** Own-yard casting is not the plan; a 1/4 blocker.

Ob Nixilis Reignited.text: **Thranduil:** In the list: +1 draws every turn and −3 is a spot kill — card advantage plus interaction at 5. **Glarb:** In the list: each +1 draw mills through Psychic Corrosion and the Tutelages, and Glarb casts it off the top.

Sheoldred, Whispering One.text: **Thranduil:** In the list: an upkeep reanimation every turn — aim it at non-Elf creatures so Thranduil keeps the Elf tools (the notes' G-42 caveat) — plus an edict each opposing upkeep; it also feeds Teval and Insidious Roots. **Glarb:** Glarb casts it off the top and the edict is real control, but its own yard holds few creatures.

The Water Crystal.text: **Thranduil:** It only adds to opponents' mill, which this list does not do. **Glarb:** In the list: "they mill that many cards plus four instead" turns every Psychic Corrosion and Tutelage trigger from two into six, and blue spells cost {1} less.

Ashiok, Nightmare Muse.text: **Thranduil:** No graveyard or card-flow tie; the −3 bounce is tempo and the exile is Glarb's plan. **Glarb:** In the list. +1 Nightmares exile two of their library on each attack or block, −3 answers any nonland permanent, and −7 casts their exiled cards; MV 5 casts off the top. Strong, but slower than the draw-mill engines.

Kamahl's Druidic Vow.text: "Put any number of land and/or legendary permanent cards with mana value X or less … onto the battlefield. Put the rest into your graveyard." **Thranduil:** In the list. 36 lands and 38 legendaries: each legendary Elf hit loots, misses fill the yard, and the Elf mana makes X big. **Glarb:** 26 legendaries, but the misses go to your own yard and an X spell cannot cast off the top.

M.O.D.O.K., Evil Intellect.text: "Whenever you draw your second card each turn, target opponent sacrifices a nontoken creature." **Thranduil:** Every Thranduil loot draws two, so each legendary Elf entering is an edict. **Glarb:** In the list. Draws twice on most turns, both players' (Theorist, Rhystic, Remora): a repeatable edict.

Matoya, Archon Elder.text: "Whenever you scry or surveil, draw a card." **Thranduil:** Only Morcant's Eyes surveils every turn; the surveil lands and Price of Fame are one-shots. **Glarb:** In the list and protected. Glarb's {T}: Surveil 2 becomes a draw every turn, and each draw mills.

Sheoldred, the Apocalypse.text: "Whenever an opponent draws a card, they lose 2 life." **Thranduil:** Each loot gains 4 and their draw step drains 2; a deathtouch body that rewards the deck's card flow. **Glarb:** In the list. Dictate makes them draw more, The Master of Lake-town turns each drain into mill, and our draws gain life.

Cloud of Darkness.text: **Thranduil:** "−X/−X, where X is the number of permanent cards in your graveyard" — the self-mill fills X fast, Yarok doubles the ETB, and it leaves a 5-mana flier: removal that scales with the plan. **Glarb:** Its own yard holds mostly spent instants and sorceries, not permanents, so X stays small and the {G}{G} is hard on two Forests.

Dionus, Elvish Archdruid.text: **Thranduil:** Each Elf untaps the first time it taps on your turn, so Priest of Titania, Archdruid and the other mana Elves tap twice, Voice and Lathril's tap costs come back, and Thranduil uses two borrowed abilities a turn; a legendary Elf, so it is also a loot. **Glarb:** One Elf (Paradise Druid) in the list, so the grant does nothing.

Glarb, Calamity's Augur.text: **Thranduil:** Surveil 2 every turn bins Elves for Thranduil, and 33 cards at MV 4+ cast off the top; overlaps Eladamri's top-of-library casting but adds the fill. **Glarb:** The commander: surveil triggers Matoya and Proft, and the MV 4+ finishers cast straight off the top.

Journey to Eternity // Atzal, Cave of Et.text: **Thranduil:** The creature returns and Atzal becomes an any-colour land that reanimates a creature each turn; Yawgmoth and Izoni sacrifice to start it. Spend Atzal on non-Elf creatures first, since reanimating an Elf trades its borrowed ability. **Glarb:** 20 creatures and no sacrifice outlet, so it rarely flips.

Price of Fame.text: **Thranduil:** Unconditional instant removal, 2 mana against a commander or other legend, and the surveil 2 bins Elves for Thranduil. **Glarb:** Same removal; the surveil triggers Matoya and Proft.

Reed Richards, Smartest Man.text: **Thranduil:** Turns the first extra draw each turn into four: Elrond's activation draw or Thranduil's loot becomes a big refill, with the discards feeding the yard; 6 mana mono-blue. **Glarb:** The first extra draw on EACH turn becomes four — Dictate's extra, Theorist's draw on their turn, Doctor Doom — and every card drawn mills through Corrosion and the Tutelages.

Thranduil, Sindarin Liege.text: **Thranduil:** The adventure mills four and pulls two lands, then the creature (a legendary Elf, so a loot) makes an Elf on every landfall, which keeps Voice and Lathril online. **Glarb:** Hybrid-castable, but the adventure mills your own library and the Elf half has nothing to feed.

Princess Yue.text: **Thranduil:** `{T}: Scry 2` sets up the top but bins nothing; it does trigger Elrond. **Glarb:** In the list: each scry triggers Matoya's draw and Proft's, so a draw a turn that mills through Corrosion and both Tutelages, and she returns as a land when she dies.

Teval, the Balanced Scale.text: **Thranduil:** In the list: mills three on each attack, returns a land, and every time cards leave the yard (Kotis, Muldrotha, Kagha, Overlord, Deathrite) makes a 2/2 Zombie — on a 4-mana flier. **Glarb:** Mills its own library; the tokens need its own yard to empty.

Thranduil, the Elvenking.text: **Thranduil:** The commander: "has all activated abilities of all Elf cards in your graveyard" and loots on each legendary Elf entering. **Glarb:** One Elf in the list (Paradise Druid) and no legendary Elves; off-plan.

Lathril, Blade of the Elves.text: **Thranduil:** In the list and protected: tapping ten Elves drains 10, and Thranduil borrows that ability from the yard; 33 Elves plus token makers reach ten, but it is the most density-dependent card. **Glarb:** One Elf in the list; off-plan.

Muldrotha, the Gravetide.text: **Thranduil:** In the list: one permanent of each type and a land from the yard every turn; the deck's core recursion. **Glarb:** Replays what Glarb surveils away, but that is incidental value.

Wrenn and Realmbreaker.text: **Thranduil:** In the list: every land taps for any colour, −2 mills three and keeps a permanent, and the +1 makes a 3/3. **Glarb:** `{1}{G}{G}` on 15 green sources; fixing the deck mostly has.

Yawgmoth's Vile Offering.text: **Thranduil:** In the list: reanimates from any yard (choose a non-Elf to spare Thranduil's tools) and kills a creature or planeswalker. **Glarb:** In the list: reanimates from the yard Glarb has milled, plus removal.

Dragonlord Silumgar.text: **Thranduil:** In the list. "Gain control of target creature or planeswalker" on a 6-mana flying deathtouch body; Yarok doubles the trigger into two steals. **Glarb:** In the list. Removal on a body that Glarb can cast off the top (mana value 6).

Proft, Consulting Detective.text: **Thranduil:** Surveil comes only from Morcant's Eyes, Price of Fame and three lands, so it draws about once a turn at {2}. **Glarb:** In the list. Glarb's {T}: Surveil 2 plus Princess Yue and Kaito trigger it every turn; each draw mills two through Corrosion.

Sheoldred // The True Scriptures.text: **Thranduil:** In the list. ETB edict (doubled by Yarok); but the transform needs eight cards in the OPPONENT's yard, which this deck does not fill, and chapter III pulls our Elves out of Thranduil's yard. **Glarb:** In the list. The mill makes the transform reliable early, and chapter III returns every creature they have milled.

High Perfect Morcant.text: **Thranduil:** In the list. Every Elf entering, tokens included, makes each opponent blight 1; "Tap three untapped Elves you control: Proliferate" grows the blight, seven planeswalkers and Marwyn/Dionus/Kotis counters, and Thranduil borrows it from the yard. A legendary Elf, so a loot. **Glarb:** One Elf (Paradise Druid), so a 4-mana 4/4 that blights once and never proliferates.

Liliana, Death Mage.text: **Thranduil:** In the list. +1 returns a creature card each turn (a non-Elf, so Thranduil keeps his tools) and triggers Teval, Oasis and Roots; −3 is removal. **Glarb:** −3 is removal and −7 drains 2 per creature card in the milled opponent's yard, a real finisher; the +1 has little to return.

Oasis of Renewal.text: **Thranduil:** In the list. Two seeks on entry, then up to two a turn "whenever a land / nonland card leaves your graveyard" — Kotis, Muldrotha, Teval, Kagha, Liliana, Overlord and Deathrite all trigger it. **Glarb:** Two cards on entry, but the deck rarely moves cards out of its own yard and seeking is not a draw.

Teferi, Temporal Pilgrim.text: **Thranduil:** A 5-mana draw walker with no graveyard synergy. **Glarb:** In the list. "0: Draw a card" every turn mills via Psychic Corrosion and the Tutelages, every draw adds loyalty, and Reed Richards turns the first extra draw into four.

The Theorist, Jace Beleren.text: "At the beginning of each opponent's draw step, you draw a card." **Thranduil:** A free card a round and Illusion tokens for Insidious Roots; blue is the light colour. **Glarb:** In the list. The off-turn draw mills via Psychic Corrosion and the Tutelages, and Reed Richards makes it four; −2 bounces.
